detail.longDescription: funny story: when I participated in a hackathon 10 years ago - i.e when I didn't even know what I'd want to pursue in IT & wasn't against AI like today. - our team have come up with an idea to stuff AI in a notes app, e.g to automatically generate tags, make a summary of existing notes, grammar check etc. it even worked. little did I know back then that "AI in notes apps" has become more or less a bad norm nowadays 🙃 # Sofware # Programming # Tech # Technology # AI # ArtificialIntelligence
